Name: Mod Update Menu Recolour - DaisyNiko's Earthy Interface
Author: 77Wanderer
Description:
[size=6][b][color=#7f6000]Howdy!
[/color][/b][/size][size=3]
This is a simple replacer for the [/size][url=https://github.com/Dphill10827/UnofficialModUpdateMenu/releases]Unofficial Mod Update Menu[/url][size=3]'s main menu button to match the colour scheme of DaisyNiko's [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13658?tab=description]Earthy Interface[/url][size=3]. 
[/size]

[size=3]Like [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/105410538]EtaMyosotis[/url][size=3], I'm surprised no one's made a patch for this mod either, thus I've followed in their footsteps with their recolour of the Generic Mod Config Menu's button! [/size]

[color=#7f6000][size=4][b]Installation:[/b][/size][/color]
[size=3]1. Download and unzip the file.
2. Place the extracted folder into the Mods folder and overwrite the file.
